_doc: EBOOT system-message overrides for the PSP options screen (project decision 2026-09-29, no R* marker). Entry numbers are PSP table slots. 'ps1': use that PS1 entry verbatim. 'lines': help-box text, built on this slot's Japanese string (its WIN/ops kept, one PAD 6 per line). 'layout_runs': keep every op of the Japanese string, replace its text runs in order ('{4F}' = 12-px space, as the Japanese full-width space). Terminology (project decision): analog pad = 'Analog Stick', D-pad = 'Directional button'. '{COL n}' (layout_runs only) = pad so the next text starts n px from the row start.

38.what: options screen labels (PSP layout: Turn / Free Look / Camera / Map / Lock-On / Screen). Columns aligned like the Japanese: labels at 24 px, first choice at 105, second at 162 ({COL n} = PAD to n px). Toggles say 'D-Pad' (project decision 2026-09-29); help lines keep 'Directional button'.

lines: The game fills the entire screen.

247.what: save screen: triangle button deletes save data (project decision 2026-09-29, no R*). Formatting (approved): box widened 15 -> 18 columns and moved left 18 px to stay centred (Japanese WIN 4800de000f01).
